Question Choices: Why does a box plot alone generally not determine the exact number of vehicles above 150,000 km?  (A) Because a box plot only shows the maximum value   (B) Because a box plot groups data into intervals   (C) Because a box plot shows quartiles and spread, not exact counts   (D) Because a box plot cannot show any data values
Hints: Check which exact values, summary positions, or interval counts the display retains.
Solution: C. A box plot shows a five-number summary and any marked outliers, not all interval frequencies or the sample size. These summaries generally do not determine an exact count above a specified cutoff.

Question Choices: Choose from histogram, pie chart, box plot, dot plot. Which display (1) marks the median directly with a line inside a box: ___; (2) uses bars to show frequencies for intervals: ___?
Hints: Check which exact values, summary positions, or interval counts the display retains.
Solution: A box plot marks the median with a line. A histogram shows interval frequencies with bars.

Question Choices: Which statement is TRUE about a dot plot?  (A) It only shows quartiles   (B) It shows exact data values   (C) It cannot be used to find the median   (D) It groups data into ranges
Hints: Check which exact values, summary positions, or interval counts the display retains.
Solution: A dot plot shows each individual data value.

Question Choices: You want to answer these two questions. (1) What is the median movie length? (2) How many movies are longer than 90 minutes? Which pair of displays would work best?: (A) Histogram-for-both    (B) Box-plot-for-both    (C) Box-plot-for-median,histogram-for-counting-above-90    (D) Dot-plot-for-counting-above-90,histogram-for-median
Hints: Which graph shows the median, and which helps count intervals?
Solution: A box plot shows the median directly; a histogram counts values in intervals.

Question Choices: Which statement is true?  (A) A box plot shows every exact data value   (B) A histogram is best for finding the exact median   (C) A box plot shows the median directly   (D) A histogram shows quartiles
Hints: Check which exact values, summary positions, or interval counts the display retains.
Solution: The line inside the box of a box plot is the median.
